description: Execute a 4-tool native workflow bundle in parallel in a single call ($0.015-$0.03) and return a unified dossier, saving 3 LLM round-trips. WHEN TO USE: Call for comprehensive multi-source due diligence on a token, company domain, repository, or research topic; use execute_marketplace_tool when you only need a single tool. WHEN NOT TO USE: Do not use for single-endpoint queries or free catalog search. PARAMETER INTERACTIONS: Select bundle_id first and provide the matching entity identifier (token/0x address, domain, repo, or URL) in target. Omit agent_id and tx_hash during your 5 free calls. Read-only and idempotent; results are cached for 1 hour (<5ms cache hit). Pricing: the first 5 calls per agent_id are free and failed calls are never charged. After 5 calls, the tool returns a payment-required quote (not a fatal error) with a $2 Stripe top-up link and Base/Solana USDC addresses; complete payment, then retry with your agd_pass_ key in agent_id or pass tx_hash. Example: execute_workflow_bundle(bundle_id='example')

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier or prepaid agd_pass_ session key. Omit during your 5 free trial calls to use an ID automatically derived from your client IP, or pass your agd_pass_ key after topping up.

bundle_id.description: Composite 4-tool workflow bundle identifier to execute in parallel.

target.description: Primary target entity for the bundle (0x contract, token symbol, company domain, GitHub repo, or URL).

tx_hash.description: Optional on-chain Base Mainnet (0x...) or Solana SPL USDC transaction hash. Omit unless settling an individual call directly on-chain instead of using an agd_pass_ key in agent_id.
